Name: Morning Stamina Adjuster
Author: Kataby44
Description:
I made this mod for myself, so I do not render food withour buffs completly useless. With this i can eat food each morning to recover my stamina after I wake up. It goes well with Love for Cooking mod.

Set how much stamina you start each morning with. Choose between 30%, 50%, or 70% in Generic Mod Config Menu.
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI [/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu [/*]
[/list][b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Start each day with reduced stamina [/*]
[*]Choose 30%, 50%, or 70% [/*]
[*]Lightweight and simple [/*]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[/list]
